title: Released the first demo of my solo RTS game, Battlefronts! Try it out
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
Hey all, some of you have been asking for a demo! This is my first project after getting into game developing a couple of weeks ago. It's been a fun journey so far and wanted to share some progress. Still in development and all feedback is welcome, thanks  
  
Try the demo: [https://ynotved.itch.io/battlefronts](https://ynotved.itch.io/battlefronts)

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body:
Check out some of my other posts for progress videos - I mostly use Godot, Aesprite and ChatGPT

Made a few prototypes to get the combat system how I liked, and then focused on polishing up the visuals

I used ChatGPT debugging, scripting help, and some placeholder art until I found assets I liked. Eventually I’ll make all original artwork once the games functions and mechanics feel right

comments.author: Monkeylashes
comments.body: dude, you have all this power in your hands, why produce slop bro? Why do the units just float over walls and buildings? This shit plays like you just sat down with claude code for a weekend. Do better.
